cleaning_notes: Natural-infection file: section rows 'Study cohort 1', 'Study cohort 2' and 'Control dogs' set group and cohort; 85 + 18 infected dogs and 14 controls.
IMHA file: 16 dogs, group 'comparator'. The article abstract says 10 IMHA dogs; 5 of the 16 have no reticulocyte indices (MCVr and later columns empty).
Experimental file: 5 dogs on days 1-6, long format (timepoint day_1 to day_6).

The 5 experimental dogs are the DS02 Beagles: ARC is equal on every DS03 day (DS03 day n = DS02 day n; the DS02 4.1 sample is left out). Field same_dog_as gives the DS02 dog_id. So DS03 'Day 1' is day 1 after inoculation, and these 5 dogs must never be pooled with DS02 as extra dogs. Of 140 shared cells (Hb, HCT, MCHC within 10 g/L, Ret% within 0.05, ARC), 1 differ: DS02:d003 day 3 hb: DS03 120.0, DS02 118.0. Both values are kept as reported in their own files.
values.setting: natural, healthy, imha or experimental. values.cohort: 1 or 2 for natural infection (two collection series, BC* and BLSC* IDs); null otherwise.
No severity label or outcome is in any DS03 file. The outcomes file is empty by design.
Units as given in the header row; MCHC is already g/L. No conversion was needed.
7 naturally infected dogs have no weight; rows with short length are padded as missing.
Overlap with S-CB050 or S-CB517 (same hospital) is possible and unverified (data.md).
Floating-point noise in the cells was rounded to 10 decimals.
